title: Design PostgreSQL schema introspection SQL queries
description: Design SQL queries to introspect PostgreSQL schema: tables, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and indexes for PostgreSQL 14+.
acceptanceCriteria: SQL queries retrieve tables and columns

evidence: database/introspection.sql — five read-only introspection queries (tables/columns with data types, primary keys, foreign keys incl. self-referencing and circular, unique constraints, indexes) for PostgreSQL 14+, using information_schema + pg_catalog only
database/seed.sql — throwaway seed schema covering composite keys, self-referencing and circular foreign keys, reserved-word table names, multiple data types
database/verify-introspection.sql — runs every introspection query against the seed schema with result markers
database/run-verification.sh — starts throwaway postgres:16-alpine container on a private Docker network (tmpfs data, no published port, per-run generated password), seeds schema, verifies, cleans up
database/README.md — documentation and driver placeholder convention ($n style)
commit 11cac9a on branch ticket/TASK-039 (5 files added, 550 insertions)

Test report: ran ./database/run-verification.sh against PostgreSQL 16 inside Docker; all 7 acceptance criteria pass — tables/columns (21 rows), data types (integer, text, boolean, timestamptz, numeric, uuid), primary keys incl. composite (employee_project_pkey positions 1,2), foreign keys incl. self-ref employee_manager_fk and circular department_head_fk (5 rows), unique constraint project_code_unique (1 row), indexes (12 rows incl. PK-backed, unique, composite)
